note: Every https://foreversixty.gg/app/* deep link (design/specs/2026-10-30-mobile-apps.md section 6.4). web/scripts/gen-mobile-links.mjs generates both apps' parsers (iOS DeepLink, Android DeepLink) and web/app-link-paths.json, the path list the universal-link and App Link files serve. A route is under /app/ unless site is true: a real site page (spec 2026-10-31-mobile-wave3 section 3.4) that also opens the apps. {param} is a path segment, a string unless params says int; query lists the optional query parameters, each with its allowed words or "string". example is a real link the tests parse.
